description: This file defines the ViewDuplicateForm class, a form controller for duplicating views in Drupal's Views UI module. It handles form creation, submission, and translation copying for duplicated views.

classes.name: ViewDuplicateForm
classes.description: A form controller class for duplicating views within Drupal's Views UI module.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the module handler and language manager.

methods.name: prepareEntity
methods.description: Prepares the entity; intentionally left empty to avoid preparation during addition.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the form for duplicating a view, including name and ID fields.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, such as the submit button.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, duplicates the view entity, and copies translations.

methods.name: copyTranslations
methods.description: Copies translations from the original view to the duplicated view for all languages.
